<h1 class="text-4xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight mb-6"><span class="lang-en">Customer Behavior Clustering</span><span class="lang-cn">客户行为聚类</span></h1>
<p class="text-lg text-slate-400 leading-relaxed mb-8"><span class="lang-en">Segmenting 48,723 customers into meaningful behavioral groups using K-Means, Hierarchical (Ward's D2), and PAM algorithms — pre-computed across multiple feature presets and cluster counts for instant Shiny exploration.</span><span class="lang-cn">使用K-Means、层次聚类（Ward's D2）和PAM算法将48,723名客户细分为有意义的行为群组——预计算了多种特征预设和聚类数量组合，以实现Shiny应用中的即时探索。</span></p>
<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">Team 13 — Ji Guofang &nbsp;|&nbsp; Lin Yan &nbsp;|&nbsp; Nguyen Trong Nhan</p>

<!-- ==================== SECTION 01 — Approach Overview ==================== -->
<section class="mb-12">
<div class="bg-[#121212] rounded-2xl border border-white/5 p-10">
<span class="text-purple-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2 block">SECTION 01</span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Approach Overview</span><span class="lang-cn">方法概述</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 leading-relaxed mb-8"><span class="lang-en">Running clustering algorithms on 48,723 records in real time is computationally prohibitive for an interactive Shiny app. Our solution: pre-compute all cluster assignments offline and let the app read results instantly.</span><span class="lang-cn">对48,723条记录实时运行聚类算法对交互式Shiny应用来说计算成本过高。我们的解决方案：离线预计算所有聚类分配，让应用即时读取结果。</span></p>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8">
<!-- Why Pre-compute -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">speed</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">Why Pre-compute?</span><span class="lang-cn">为何预计算？</span></h4>
</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed"><span class="lang-en">K-Means, hierarchical, and PAM all require iterative distance calculations across 48,723 observations. Even a single run of PAM can take 30+ seconds. With multiple k values, algorithms, and feature presets, live computation would make the Shiny app unusable.</span><span class="lang-cn">K-Means、层次聚类和PAM都需要对48,723个观测值进行迭代距离计算。即使单次运行PAM也可能需要30秒以上。面对多个k值、算法和特征预设组合，实时计算会使Shiny应用无法使用。</span></p>
</div>

<!-- What We Pre-compute -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">inventory_2</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">What We Pre-compute</span><span class="lang-cn">预计算内容</span></h4>
</div>
<div class="space-y-2 text-sm">
<p class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en"><span class="text-white font-semibold">k = 2 to 8</span> — cluster counts</span><span class="lang-cn"><span class="text-white font-semibold">k = 2至8</span> — 聚类数量</span></p>
<p class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en"><span class="text-white font-semibold">3 algorithms</span> — K-Means, Hierarchical (Ward's D2), PAM</span><span class="lang-cn"><span class="text-white font-semibold">3种算法</span> — K-Means、层次聚类（Ward's D2）、PAM</span></p>
<p class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en"><span class="text-white font-semibold">3 feature presets</span> — RFM, Full Behavioral, Engagement</span><span class="lang-cn"><span class="text-white font-semibold">3种特征预设</span> — RFM、完整行为、参与度</span></p>
<p class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en"><span class="text-white font-semibold">63 combinations</span> total stored in a single <code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">.rds</code> file</span><span class="lang-cn"><span class="text-white font-semibold">63种组合</span>全部存储在单个 <code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">.rds</code> 文件中</span></p>
</div>
</div>

<!-- User Experience -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">touch_app</span>

</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-3"><span class="lang-en">The user selects an algorithm, feature preset, and k via a slider. The app reads the matching pre-computed labels instantly — no waiting for model convergence.</span><span class="lang-cn">用户通过滑块选择算法、特征预设和k值。应用即时读取匹配的预计算标签——无需等待模型收敛。</span></p>
<div class="bg-[#080808] rounded-lg p-4">

</div>

<!-- ==================== SECTION 02 — Feature Selection ==================== -->
<section class="mb-12">
<div class="bg-[#121212] rounded-2xl border border-white/5 p-10">
<span class="text-purple-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2 block">SECTION 02</span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Feature Selection</span><span class="lang-cn">特征选择</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 leading-relaxed mb-8"><span class="lang-en">Different clustering objectives require different feature sets. We offer three curated presets plus a custom option, all z-score standardized before clustering to ensure no single variable dominates distance calculations.</span><span class="lang-cn">不同的聚类目标需要不同的特征集。我们提供三种精选预设和一个自定义选项，所有特征在聚类前均经过Z-score标准化，确保没有单一变量主导距离计算。</span></p>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8">

</div>

<!-- Custom Option Note -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">build</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">Custom Feature Selection</span><span class="lang-cn">自定义特征选择</span></h4>
</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed"><span class="lang-en">Beyond the three presets, users can build a custom feature set by selecting any combination of available numeric variables. All selected features are automatically z-score standardized (<code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">scale()</code>) before being passed to the clustering algorithm, ensuring each variable contributes equally to distance calculations regardless of its original unit or scale.</span><span class="lang-cn">除三种预设外，用户可通过选择任意可用数值变量组合来构建自定义特征集。所有选定特征在传递给聚类算法之前自动进行Z-score标准化（<code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">scale()</code>），确保每个变量无论其原始单位或尺度如何，均对距离计算贡献相等。</span></p>
</div>

</div>
</section>

<!-- ==================== SECTION 04 — Cluster Evaluation ==================== -->
<section class="mb-12">
<div class="bg-[#121212] rounded-2xl border border-white/5 p-10">
<span class="text-purple-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2 block">SECTION 04</span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Cluster Evaluation</span><span class="lang-cn">聚类评估</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 leading-relaxed mb-8"><span class="lang-en">Choosing the optimal number of clusters requires converging evidence from multiple validation methods. We combine three complementary approaches and enable side-by-side algorithm comparison.</span><span class="lang-cn">选择最优聚类数量需要多种验证方法的汇聚证据。我们结合三种互补方法，并支持算法并列比较。</span></p>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-6">
<!-- Elbow Method -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">show_chart</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">Elbow Method (WSS Plot)</span><span class="lang-cn">肘部法则（WSS图）</span></h4>
</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Plots total within-cluster sum of squares against k. The "elbow" — the point where adding more clusters yields diminishing returns in variance reduction — suggests the optimal k.</span><span class="lang-cn">绘制组内平方和总和与k值的关系图。"肘部"——即增加更多聚类在方差缩减方面收益递减的点——指示最优k值。</span></p>
<div class="bg-[#080808] rounded-lg p-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">info</span>
<span class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en">WSS always decreases as k increases; the key is finding where the rate of decrease sharply flattens.</span><span class="lang-cn">WSS始终随k增大而减小；关键是找到下降速率急剧趋平的位置。</span></span>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Silhouette Analysis -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">equalizer</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">Silhouette Analysis</span><span class="lang-cn">轮廓分析</span></h4>
</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Measures how similar each point is to its own cluster vs. neighboring clusters. The average silhouette width (ranging from &minus;1 to 1) quantifies cluster cohesion and separation.</span><span class="lang-cn">衡量每个点与其所属聚类相比相邻聚类的相似程度。平均轮廓宽度（范围从&minus;1到1）量化聚类的凝聚度和分离度。</span></p>
<div class="bg-[#080808] rounded-lg p-4">
<div class="space-y-2 text-sm">
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en">Close to 1.0</span><span class="lang-cn">接近1.0</span></span>
<span class="text-green-400 font-semibold"><span class="lang-en">Well-clustered</span><span class="lang-cn">聚类良好</span></span>
</div>
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en">Close to 0.0</span><span class="lang-cn">接近0.0</span></span>
<span class="text-yellow-400 font-semibold"><span class="lang-en">On boundary</span><span class="lang-cn">在边界上</span></span>
</div>
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en">Negative</span><span class="lang-cn">负值</span></span>
<span class="text-red-400 font-semibold"><span class="lang-en">Misclassified</span><span class="lang-cn">错分</span></span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
<!-- NbClust Consensus -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">how_to_vote</span>
<h4 class="text-lg font-bold"><span class="lang-en">NbClust Consensus Voting</span><span class="lang-cn">NbClust 共识投票</span></h4>
</div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-4"><span class="lang-en">The <code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">NbClust</code> package evaluates up to 30 statistical indices (Calinski-Harabasz, Dunn, Gap, etc.) and tallies which k each index recommends. The k with the most "votes" is the consensus optimal.</span><span class="lang-cn"><code class="text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">NbClust</code> 包评估多达30个统计指标（Calinski-Harabasz、Dunn、Gap等），并统计每个指标推荐的k值。获得最多"投票"的k值为共识最优值。</span></p>
<div class="bg-[#080808] rounded-lg p-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400">info</span>
<span class="text-slate-400"><span class="lang-en">Majority-rule voting across 30 indices provides a more robust recommendation than any single metric alone.</span><span class="lang-cn">跨30个指标的多数规则投票比任何单一指标提供更稳健的推荐。</span></span>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Algorithm Comparison -->
<div class="bg-[#0d0d0d] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">

</div>

Key comparison metrics:</span><span class="lang-cn">对于相同的特征预设和k值，用户可以比较K-Means、层次聚类和PAM如何以不同方式划分数据。关键比较指标：</span></p>

<span class="text-slate-300"><span class="lang-en">Average silhouette width per algorithm</span><span class="lang-cn">每种算法的平均轮廓宽度</span></span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-green-500 text-base">check_circle</span>
<span class="text-slate-300"><span class="lang-en">Cluster size balance (evenness)</span><span class="lang-cn">聚类大小均衡性</span></span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-green-500 text-base">check_circle</span>
<span class="text-slate-300"><span class="lang-en">PCA scatter overlap between assignments</span><span class="lang-cn">分配之间的PCA散点重叠度</span></span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">

<span class="text-slate-300"><span class="lang-en">Profile interpretability</span><span class="lang-cn">画像可解释性</span></span>
</div>
</div>
